note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PS5 list as mirrored by Exophase and PSNProfiles (frozen 2026-11-18). Guides are written in the author's own words from the cited sources; five trophies had no confirmed unlock method at launch and say so plainly.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap in this guide: story first, then side stories, then the long 100% grind. Press outlets estimate around 200 hours for the full run; that is their estimate, not an official figure.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed — play the story and it pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Chapter trophies can pop as the next chapter begins rather than on the final cutscene, so do not worry if it is a beat late. Before Chapter 1 ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation — see Positive Mental Attitude, the one trophy that can be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From here Jason and Lucia are both playable, and you can call the other one in as a partner — that is what unlocks the partner trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. While you are in Chapter 3, do Race Against Yago the moment the street race appears (hourglass icon) — it is time-sensitive, so save first, then race.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of the chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vaults — the start of the Maximum Withdrawal chain.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it — there is no mission replay, so that save is your only way back.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable — it pops as the story takes you there.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable — story progress only.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Unmissable — story progress only.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Unmissable — story progress only.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. Unmissable — story progress only.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable — story progress only.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist itself only opens after the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), but everything you did earlier still counts. Beyond this trophy's own counters, 100% also needs 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The PSN counter reads 0/9, so work through the list: races, fishing, arcade games, the shooting range, drone races, bowling, meditation, gym training and the rest.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the two ranges. Check each challenge's progress in-game and clear them one range at a time.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough — the counter tracks 0/14, so keep a note of which spots are done.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same race do not count twice, so spread your wins across street races, drone races and the other race types, and watch the 0/20 counter.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. You can do this from Chapter 1, and it was already being earned on launch day, so do not leave it for the endgame.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game. Available from Chapter 1 — one full game is all it takes.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline with its final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only. It stays open after the credits, and it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline with its final mission. It stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline with its final mission. It stays open after the credits and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3, Yago's street-racing strand) is time-sensitive — do it the moment it appears.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Not every optional questline counts — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not count here, so check the counter after each strand. In Chapter 3, Race Against Yago is time-sensitive: save first, then race the moment it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline with its final mission. It stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline with its final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only. It stays open after the credits and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: THE ONLY MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after Chapter 1. No mission replay, no New Game Plus.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot should count twice if you meditate there with both characters — bring your partner every time. THE MISSABLE ONE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1. After Lucia is home, check the kitchen in the morning (a morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time); she heads to the balcony of Jason's house to meditate — follow her and accept the optional task. It is gone once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay or New Game Plus, so do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops. It is not confirmed that the trophy strictly needs the balcony spot — do it anyway.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting strand is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. It stays open after the credits.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — track each set in the in-game collection menu.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app. Scanning a vehicle with WAiNK also counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive and the two counters grow together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, listed under Progress and then Challenges. There are 80 in total and 100% needs 70 — many complete on their own while you play.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. You need Jason and Lucia together — call your partner in from Chapter 2. Bank vault jobs hand you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner earns this too. The trophy only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it — scan traffic as you drive. 100% needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming. Pick a group of gang enemies, such as guards at an illegal operation, and use an assault rifle; Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Gates E3 and E4 work. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off. The pop is delayed: fly about 1 km away from the airport. Save first — the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a military tank (Rhino). Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Go to a store's locked back door and use the Snap Gun on it — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if spotted, reload.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4. Tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone — bring your partner. Vault jobs give a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. 100% needs all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Progress is tracked per area in-game — mop up unvisited areas after the story.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. 100% needs all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The trophy's own description — enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — is the only hint, and no guide has confirmed a location or steps yet. Do not chase a specific spot from rumour; check the cited guides again after launch, once a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — smashing your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — is the only hint, and no guide has confirmed a showroom, a vehicle or a method yet. Do not treat any rumoured showroom as fact; check the cited guides again once a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation visited in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe — blow it open with a Sticky Bomb. Then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so nothing here is missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reported, not fully confirmed: this should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you. Treat the max-Strength link as reported by guides, not yet proven.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Take 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind. One warning from the guides: PowerPyx and GTABase both say the Irredeemable Criminal Profile state is permanent — read a Criminal Profile guide before a rampage.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — Second time's the charm — is the only hint. Read as a hint it suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something, but that is only reading the description, not a confirmed method. Check the cited guides again once a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description — What the hell just happened? — is the only hint, and no guide has confirmed a trigger yet. Read as a hint it suggests witnessing something strange or unexplained, but that is only reading the description, not a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch. The description itself names the act — bowling someone over with a melee drive-by — so a melee drive-by means striking someone with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. But the exact trigger that pops the trophy is still unconfirmed: do not treat any rumoured target or spot as fact, and check the cited guides again once a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts, counted cumulatively. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; launder them by selling to contacts.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, counted cumulatively, in every kind of shop.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app. Take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space — buy garages first and register cheap cars.
